issues: No sign of getting around the measurement: MACCS keys are computed from each molecule's SMILES alone. The change doesn't read files, doesn't hard-code answers and doesn't use test labels.
No bug found: the 167-bit MACCS vector is added to the Morgan fingerprint and descriptor features in the same way for training and test molecules, so the feature matrix has the same shape for both.

Recomputed z: candidate mean is (0.3839+0.3807)/2 = 0.3823, incumbent mean is 0.3886, difference 0.0063. With noise sd 0.0037 and 2 runs on each side, SE = sqrt(0.0037²/2 + 0.0037²/2) = 0.0037, so z ≈ 1.70. This matches the harness's 1.691 up to rounding of the means.
Caveat, not a veto: the accept is borderline. It rests on only 2 runs per side and z of about 1.7, so the gain could be noise. The change is simple, though, so it fits the card's simplicity rule.
